title: Add automated impact statements for model version rollouts
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: release notes for model updates are inconsistent and often miss the concrete operational impact (latency/cost/quality tradeoffs) that engineers need to make rollout decisions. This PR introduces an automated "impact statement" generator that synthesizes a short, human-readable summary from model metadata diffs and performance profile deltas. The generator is conservative by default and emits a confidence score and fallback suggestion when data is sparse. Implementation highlights: (1) delta-based summarizer that consumes two model profiles (baseline, candidate) and computes per-metric significance, median/CI deltas, and cost-per-1M-token estimates; (2) template engine that converts computed signals into a 1-3 sentence impact statement plus bullet micro-notes; (3) API and UI integration so statements are surfaced on the model version page and included in the changelog export; (4) CLI hook (mrctl annotate-impact) and a registry webhook for auto-attaching statements on release. Checklist: [x] core summarizer and heuristics, [x] API surface (/v1/models/:id/impact), [x] UI column + detail modal, [x] CLI command, [x] unit and e2e tests, [x] docs and examples, [x] feature flag (impact-gen.enabled) for safe rollout. Related work: ENG-4132 (release-quality release notes), ENG-4210 (model-profile schemas). Risk & mitigations: generator includes a confidence threshold and will attach a "needs manual review" flag when data is insufficient; output is stored as an annotation (not overwriting hand-authored notes). See the sample generated statement and technical notes fields below.

registry/impact/significance.py -- statistical thresholds and CI calculator
release_notes: Introduce automated impact statements for model rollouts: concise, confidence-scored summaries of performance/cost/metadata deltas included in model version pages and changelog exports. Feature gated and disabled by default.
sample_generated_statement: Candidate v1.3 vs baseline v1.2: Quality: +0.8% (BLEU-like eval median, 95% CI: +0.2% to +1.4%) — improvement likely. Latency: +12ms p50 (+6%); Cost: estimated +$0.30 per 1M tokens on current Dedicated profile. Notes: candidate uses int8 quantization but a modified tokenizer that increases avg seq length by ~2 tokens. Confidence: 0.82. Suggested action: canary rollout with traffic cap 10% and monitor latency SLOs for first 24h.
technical_notes: Scoring uses bootstrap CI on sampled eval runs when >20 samples; falls back to non-parametric delta otherwise. Cost estimates normalized to per-1M-token using current infra cost model (config/units.yml). Impact generation respects private evals: raw artifacts never leave the customer's project; only aggregated deltas are stored. Feature flag and per-customer opt-out present.
